book.name: Uraat To Yes Mbaŋooŋa
book.title: Uraat To Yes Mbaŋooŋa To Yesu Krisi Wok Bilong Ol Aposel—The Acts Of The Apostles

content: Tighur tamtoghon liim ve ru pa tiuul yes mbaŋooŋa

Sawa tonenen, yes to titaghon Yesu tivot tinim ival. Eemoghon pataŋani eez ivot ila sosodi. Yes Yuda to tisavsaav ila Grika aliŋadi, tiyou avodi pa nditadi to tisavsaav ila saveeŋ Hibru tighaze: Ndag to naol ne, sawa to reiŋ ulaaŋ pida pa yes mbolaaŋa, nditadi to tisavsaav ila saveeŋ Hibru, matadi iŋgal yes Grika ndinaara todi kat maau.

Tovenen yes mbaŋooŋa saaŋgul ve ru tipoi tamtoghon tisob to titaghon Yesu tinim tilup di, ve tisaav padi tighaze: “Yam toŋvetaz, aghita. Ighaze yei mbaŋooŋa nigham uraat pa reiŋ aniiŋ, ve nipul uraat to votiaaŋ Maaron aliŋa, nene deŋia maau.

Tovenen yam atiir taumim, ve aghur lemim tamtoghon liim ve ru to varudi toman ŋgar todi popoia, ve ŋgar to Avuvu Patabuaŋ ivon ila lolodi. Leso nipul uraat to reiŋ aniiŋ ve ulaaŋ pida ila nimadi. 1Tim 3:2+; Tit 1:6+
Ve yei pale nineep pa suŋuuŋ moghon, ve uraat to patoŋaaŋ tamtoghon pa Maaron aliŋa.”

Ival tiina tilooŋ saveeŋ todi tonene, ve tisob tiyok pani. Tovenen tighur Stepanus (ye ghurla toni iyaryaaŋ kat, ve ŋgar to Avuvu Patabuaŋ ivon ila lolo), ve Pilip yesuru Prokorus, Nikanor, Timon, Parmenas, ve Nikolas to ndug Antiok. Nikolas tonene, ye Yuda kat maau. Eemoghon itoor ŋgar toni ila pa Maaron, ve itaghon yes Yuda pa suŋuuŋ todi.
Tigham ndiran liim ve ru tonowen tinim tiyoon ila yes mbaŋooŋa matadi, ghoro mbaŋooŋa tighur nimadi izala poghodi, ve tighason Maaron pa ipalot di, ve tighur di pa uraat.

Sawa tonenen, Maaron saveeŋ toni ilaan toman tapiri irau ndug ndug. Tovenen Yesu taghoniiŋa toni tivot tinim ival le ival kat izi Yerusalem. Yes ndiran to watooŋrau paam, tamtoghon todi katindi titoor ŋgar todi, ve tighur ila to Krisi, ve titaghon ataam toni. Mbaŋ 12:24, 19:20

Stepanus, ye ŋgeu eez to Maaron tapiri ve poia toni ivon ila lolo kat. Tovenen ighamgham mbeb gharatooŋadi tintina tivotvot ila tamtoghon matadi. Mbeb tonowen tinim ghilalooŋ pani tighaze Maaron ineep tomani pa uraat toni. Mbaŋ 2:43

Yuda pida, muuŋ tinim mbesooŋa sorok. Eemoghon tipas di pa uraat todi, ve ŋgaramus tinim mbesooŋa pa tamtoghon muul maau. Tiŋgin taudi. Yes tipamundigin lupuuŋ eez, ve tiwaat iza tighaze ‘Lupuuŋ to yes to tinim mbesooŋa muul maau.’ Lupuuŋ tonowen tamtoghona pida timundig, ve yesŋa Stepanus tiwazoran di pa savsaveeŋ. Ndiran tonowen, pida to ndug Sairini, pida to Aleksandria, pida to taan to Silisia, ve pida to taan to Asia.
Eemoghon yes tirau Stepanus maau. Pasa, ye le ŋgar tiina, ve Avuvu Patabuaŋ ipapalot saveeŋ toni. Lu 21:15
Tovenen tikaal ataam pani, ve tipazaagh tamtoghon pida ve tiŋgal saveeŋ pani tighaze: “Yei nilooŋ ŋgeu tonene ipiyaav saveeŋ velegiiŋ pa Mose ve Maaron.” Mt 26:59+

Tisaav tovene, le tipazaagh ival tiina to yes Yuda, toman ŋginiiŋa todi ve yes ŋgara to tutuuŋ. Tovenen timundig tila tikis Stepanus, ve tiweua ilooŋ ila lupuuŋ to yes daba to yes Yuda, ve tipayoonda ila matadi.

Ghoro tiyou ndiran kaaromŋa pida tinim, ve tipayoon di ila lupuuŋ tonowen matadi paam, ve yes kaaromŋa tonowen tiŋgal saveeŋ pa Stepanus tighaze: “Ŋgeu tonene, sawa isob, isasavia saveeŋ velegiiŋ iŋarua rumai patabuaŋ to Maaron ve tutuuŋ to Mose.
Yei nilooŋa ighaze Yesu to Nasaret pale ireu Rumai Tiina tonene izi. Ve tutuuŋ to Mose igham pait ve tataghoni to muuŋ ve inim ne paam, ye pale itoora.” Mt 5:17; Mk 14:57+; Yo 2:20+
Yes to tineep ila lupuuŋ tonenen tilooŋ saveeŋ tonene, le tisob matadi deŋia pa Stepanus, ve tighita nagho isul inimale aŋela.

footnotes.text: Yes to tisavsaav ila Grika aliŋadi, to tiyou avodi pa uraat to reiŋ aniiŋ. Ndiran liim ve ru to tighur di pa uraat ne, izadi ipatooŋ di ighaze yes tinepneep toman Grika ve tiwatag Grika gabuadi. Tauto yes mbaŋooŋa tighur di pa tiŋgin uraat tonowen.
